\appendix
\section{Full Feature Correlation Rankings}
\label{app:feature_rankings}
%% ============================================================================

Tables~\ref{tab:app_ae_ranking} and~\ref{tab:app_us_ranking} list the complete
Spearman and Pearson correlations with $\kappa$ for all AE and US features that
passed the initial data quality filter, sorted by combined rank.
Features retained after the Stage~2 redundancy reduction are indicated with a
checkmark.
